about: Reference heights the landmark models are checked against by scripts/check-heights.mjs (npm run check:heights). Figures come from docs/reference/heights.md (web research, November 2026; that file is not committed). h is metres, a number or [low, high]. base 'ground' measures from the ground at the footprint's centre; base 'model' from the lowest point of the model inside the footprint, for a building on a terrace the model builds well above the ground. A model passes when it lies within the range widened by the tolerance for its confidence. An entry with 'known' is a discrepancy already on record: it is reported as WARN and does not fail the check; remove the field once the model or the figure is fixed.

landmarks.name: Chợ Đông Ba, main hall
landmarks.source: GISHue drone survey (data/raw/heights/gishue, 90th percentile 11 m over the hall) and Google Open Buildings 2.5D 2023 (11-15 m); three storeys, https://vnexpress.net/kham-pha-cho-dong-ba-4127933.html ("Chợ gồm ba lầu"); no clock tower today (demolished 1967; 2024 entrance photo, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dong_Ba_Market_(Hue)_-_Ch%E1%BB%A3_%C4%90%C3%B4ng_Ba_Hu%E1%BA%BF_(July_2024)_-_img_02.jpg). See docs/places/dongba.md

landmarks.name: Nhà Thờ Phủ Cam
landmarks.source: https://vietnamnet.vn/en/the-remarkable-architecture-of-hue-s-nearly-40-year-cathedral-project-2555264.html (two bell towers, each 43.5 m); Huế provincial tourism page (hai tháp chuông cao 43,5m). The earlier 50 m is VinWonders' estimate.

landmarks.name: Nhà Thờ Dòng Chúa Cứu Thế
landmarks.source: vi.wikipedia (Nhà thờ Dòng Chúa Cứu Thế, Huế) and VietNamNet: the bell tower with its spire, 53 m; the photos put that one tower over the crossing.

landmarks.name: Chùa Diệu Đế, Đại Giác hall
Cung An Định, Khải Tường Lâu
Tháp nước Dã Viên
landmarks.source: vietnamnews.vn/sunday/1484298/tranquil-da-vien-islet-in-hue-renovated.html ("a 40m water tower"); city height survey (OSM) 41.8 m. See docs/places/davien.md

landmarks.name: Minh Mạng, Minh Lâu (on its mound)
Thiệu Trị, Đức Hinh lâu
landmarks.source: https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/L%C4%83ng_Thi%E1%BB%87u_Tr%E1%BB%8B (Đức Hinh lâu on a low hill, on an 18.5 x 18.5 m foundation, 'tương tự như Minh Lâu ở lăng Minh Mạng'); https://baovanhoa.vn/van-hoa/di-tich-lang-vua-thieu-tri-dang-duoc-tu-bo-nhu-the-nao-216933.html (restored to its original state: timber frame, yellow-glazed tiles). Drawn complete, two storeys like Minh Lâu (13-14 m); the height is estimated from Minh Lâu. The model measures 13.7 m. See docs/places/thieutri.md

landmarks.name: Thái Miếu, Thái Tổ Miếu (as before 1947)
landmarks.source: No pre-1947 height found. 71 x 27 m, trùng thiềm điệp ốc, 15+2 / 13+2 bays (https://baovanhoa.vn/van-hoa/di-tich-thai-mieu-dai-noi-hue-se-duoc-trung-tu-nhu-the-nao-109477.html); proportions taken from Thế Miếu, the same type (27.7 m deep, ridge 10.5 m over a ~1 m base); ridge 11 m over the ground, the pháp lam sun disc on it to about 13.5 m (the check measures the highest point). See docs/places/thaimieu.md

landmarks.name: Điện Cần Chánh (restored, finished)
landmarks.source: No published height. Floor ~1.15 m above the ground (vi.wikipedia: nền cao gần 1 m above the court); main columns up to 9.4 m long (dtinews.dantri.com.vn/print/20260310141329875.htm), so the upper roof is set 0.35 m steeper than Thái Hòa's: ridge 11.15 m, ridge disc top 12.2 m. See docs/places/canchanh.md

landmarks.name: Đại Cung Môn (drawn as before 1947)
landmarks.source: No documented height. One-storey 5-bay timber gate on a foundation about 0.9 m high (khamphahue.com.vn, baovanhoa.vn: 5 gian, 3 cửa, foundation ~23.7 x 12.5 m); ridge set below Thái Hòa's 11.8 m and in proportion to the 22 m frame; top of the ridge pearl about 9.2 m. See docs/places/daicungmon.md.

landmarks.name: Vạc đồng before Tả Vu (1660)
landmarks.source: khamphahue.com.vn, The Nguyen Dynasty Copper Cauldrons: body 1.05 m, 1.30 m to the handle tops, mouth 2.2 m. Model rim 2.0 m. See docs/places/courtyard-objects.md

landmarks.name: Kỳ lân before Thái Hòa, east (bronze, on its plinth)
landmarks.source: Frommers, Thai Hoa Palace: 'In front are two mythical ky lin animals'. Size not given; model 0.55 m plinth + 1.46 m statue on Đan Bệ. docs/places/courtyard-objects.md

landmarks.name: Kỳ lân before Thái Hòa, west (bronze, on its plinth)
Vạc đồng left (east) of Thái Hòa
landmarks.source: khamphahue.com.vn, The Nguyen Dynasty Copper Cauldrons: one vạc 'on the left side of the Thái Hòa Palace'; its size is not given (the Tả Vu vạc, the largest, is 1.30 m to the handle tops). Model rim 1.9 m.

landmarks.name: Thế Miếu kỳ lân kiosk (thiết đình), east
landmarks.source: vi.wikipedia, Thế Tổ Miếu (hoàng thành Huế): 'một đôi kỳ lân bằng đồng đứng trong thiết đình'. Form and size not given; model slab 0.25 + posts 3.3 + roof 1.25 m.
